compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: AP7313-33SAG-7 assigns IN (VIN) whereas AP7313-33SRG-7 assigns GND (GND) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: AP7313-33SAG-7 assigns GND (GND) whereas AP7313-33SRG-7 assigns IN (VIN) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.

parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.
Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (VIN vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs VIN). Soldering AP7313-33SRG-7 onto a AP7313-33SAG-7 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
BENCH VERIFICATION: Confirm thermal dissipation margin using θJA (AP7313-33SAG-7: 207 °C/W vs AP7313-33SRG-7: 230 °C/W) and worst-case ambient temperature (-40..85 °C vs -40..85 °C).
engineering_verdict: AP7313-33SAG-7 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-3) and AP7313-33SRG-7 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-3) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (VIN vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs VIN). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (VIN vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs VIN). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 52.8 °C on AP7313-33SAG-7 (θJA 207 °C/W) vs 58.6 °C on AP7313-33SRG-7 (θJA 230 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 1x ratio (55 µA (p.5) vs 55 µA (p.5)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP7313-33SAG-7 "Single-Letter Ordering Trap: SA vs SR/AP2210N Reverses Pins 1 & 3 (and LM3480 Differs Too)" (p.2) and AP7313-33SRG-7 "Reversed SOT23R Pinout Matches AP2210N (1=GND, 2=OUT, 3=IN), NOT AP7313-SA or LM3480" (p.2). BOM decision: Choose AP7313-33SAG-7 when matching your existing Diodes Incorporated SOT-23-3 (SA (SOT23)) qualification and -40..85 °C grade; choose AP7313-33SRG-7 when matching your existing Diodes Incorporated SOT-23-3 (SR (SOT23R)) qualification and -40..85 °C grade. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.2 vs TOP_VIEW p.2) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
